scope: six existing project assets only; no image edit, import, engine run or canonical write
selection_note: The native notice is preferred over the much larger notice_pavilion_v2 because it has a clean compact silhouette. No safe existing dye vat was admitted in this bounded scan; the cloth rack is the readable cloth-workshop identifier.

assets.style_and_use: weathered stone ring, timber hoist and bucket; strong courtyard landmark
assets.admission_limit: already used in Linxi, but complete A1 contains a large warm weak-alpha halo; reuse in Luoyang requires native visual review and must preserve the existing nonuniform formal scale/collider relationship or derive a new verified geometry contract

assets.recommended_role: compact guild/work-order notice at the common lane
assets.style_and_use: small project-native timber notice with gray cap; visually simpler than generated buildings but clean and readable
assets.admission_limit: two post feet only; the open gap between posts must remain passable unless System geometry proves otherwise

assets.style_and_use: three-tier wooden rack with blue, rust, cream and green fabric; clearly distinguishes the cloth trade without another full building
assets.admission_limit: existing generated asset has weak-alpha tails touching the canvas; preserve complete A1 and require actual exterior preview before formal use

assets.style_and_use: heavy iron anvil on a worn timber stump; strong smith identity at adult scale
assets.admission_limit: manual image-guided footprint inherited from the existing smithy author; System still needs exterior 875+17 and native overlap checks

assets.style_and_use: static two-wheel wooden cart, already used in the docks workyard
assets.admission_limit: oblique three-quarter asset; align it with a service lane, never across a main pedestrian lane, and reuse the existing full conservative hull

assets.recommended_role: general store or grain merchant frontage stock
assets.style_and_use: five tied sacks on one low pallet; suitable for a general store, not for tailoring or smithing
assets.admission_limit: already used in the docks workyard; preserve the whole pallet as one blocker and do not treat the gaps between legs as walkable

placement_rules: Use the notice and well only in the shared courtyard or lane node, not in front of room portals.
Use one primary trade prop per frontage: cloth rack for cloth work, anvil for smithing, cart for carpentry/haulage, sacks for general goods.
Keep complete A1 visual envelopes separate from collision; never derive physics from A16 diagnostic boxes.
All proposed solids remain candidate geometry until the new artisans scene passes route, 875+17 and native visual checks.
not_claimed: all selected assets visually clean in the new exterior
